mapper.select: SELECT t.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_name, c.customer_phone as customer_phone, a.agent_name as agent_name, h.house_title as house_title, h.house_address as house_address FROM h_transaction t LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON t.agent_id = a.agent_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON t.house_id = h.house_id WHERE t.transaction_id = #{id}

SELECT t.*, a.agent_name as agent_name, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_transaction t LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON t.agent_id = a.agent_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON t.house_id = h.house_id WHERE t.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY t.transaction_create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_name, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_transaction t LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON t.house_id = h.house_id WHERE t.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY t.transaction_create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, c.customer_nickname as customer_name, c.customer_phone as customer_phone, a.agent_name as agent_name, h.house_title as house_title FROM h_transaction t LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON t.agent_id = a.agent_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON t.house_id = h.house_id WHERE t.transaction_no = #{transactionNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE h_transaction SET transaction_status = #{status}, transaction_status_history = #{statusHistory}, transaction_update_time = NOW() WHERE transaction_id = #{id}
UPDATE h_transaction SET transaction_final_price = #{newPrice}, transaction_status_history = #{statusHistory}, transaction_update_time = NOW() WHERE transaction_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTransactionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedTransactionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingTransactionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negotiatingTransactionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signedTransactionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledTransactionCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 THEN t.transaction_final_price ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) AS completedSalesAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 THEN t.transaction_final_price END), 2), 0) AS averageDealPrice, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN t.transaction_final_price ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) AS currentMonthSalesAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthCompletedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN t.transaction_final_price ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) AS lastMonthSalesAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthCompletedCount FROM h_transaction t

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.transaction_final_price), 2), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.transaction_final_price), 2), 0) AS averagePrice FROM h_transaction t WHERE t.transaction_status = 3 AND COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)) >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT t.transaction_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM h_transaction t GROUP BY t.transaction_status ORDER BY t.transaction_status ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.transaction_final_price), 2), 0) AS salesAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.transaction_final_price), 2), 0) AS averagePrice FROM h_transaction t WHERE t.transaction_status = 3 AND t.agent_id = #{agentId} AND COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)) >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.transaction_deal_date, DATE(t.transaction_update_time)), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
